paragraphs.text: Pontotoc’s boys will play Grissom of Huntsville, Alabama, at 11:30 a.m. Friday, Nov. 27, in Corinth. The Warriors play on the opening day of the Lighthouse Classic. Corinth High School’s calendar lists the event for both Friday and Saturday of Thanksgiving weekend.

The Warriors head into Thursday’s trip to Tupelo coming off a 68–34 home win over Louisville on Tuesday. It was the most Pontotoc had scored in its first three games. The Warriors opened with a 55–44 win over Lake Cormorant and lost 63–44 to DeSoto Central.
Grissom also won by more than 30 points in its most recent game, beating St. John Paul II 71–36 on Monday. The Tigers list Sparkman, LeFlore and North Little Rock before their meeting with Pontotoc.

The Warriors have Thanksgiving basketball on both sides of the holiday. Before their Friday game in Corinth, they have Florence on the schedule at 4:30 p.m. Monday, Nov. 23. For fans who want to see the Warriors at home, Houston visits Tuesday, Dec. 1, at 7:15 p.m.
